entities.name: Drana
entities.description: A vampire bloodchief who leads the last refugees of Guul Draz, drinks from an Eldrazi sire to recover her memories, and decides to take her people to Sea Gate.

entities.name: Kan
entities.description: One of Drana's personal overseers for millennia, laconic and loyal.

entities.name: Enkindi
entities.description: A kor leader sent by Gideon to find survivors on Guul Draz; he dies leading the charge on the Eldrazi sire.

entities.name: Melindra
entities.description: A young kor orphan in the Orphans' Brigade who fights Eldrazi and whom Drana grows fond of.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Planeswalker raising an army at Sea Gate whom Drana has only heard of.

entities.name: Kalitas
entities.description: A vampire who with the Ghet tried to turn Malakir's vampires into Eldrazi thralls and was driven off by Drana.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan Drana recalls as her master and maker.

entities.name: The Eldrazi sire
entities.description: A hundred-foot Eldrazi lord leading the host pursuing the vampires, killed after Drana drinks from its heart.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The monstrous swarm overrunning Guul Draz.

entities.name: The nulls
entities.description: Slavering creatures that haul the refugees' sleds.

entities.name: The Orphans' Brigade
entities.description: A band of orphan children that Drana lets name themselves and uses as bait for the sire.

entities.name: The vampires of Guul Draz
entities.description: Drana's vampire army and the mortal refugees traveling with them.

entities.name: The kor
entities.description: Kor warriors flying kitesails who join Drana's fight.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: The vampire continent being devoured by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Malakir
entities.description: The vampire city Drana retook then lost.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The city on Tazeem where Gideon gathers his army.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: The island across the narrow ocean from Guul Draz.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane the Eldrazi are overrunning.

events.summary: Drana surveys her refugees fleeing the Eldrazi host across Guul Draz.
events.quote: There in the midst of the host was the enormous Eldrazi sire

events.summary: A hundred kor on kitesails arrive from Tazeem, and Drana decides to welcome them.
events.quote: "Welcome. They come to join us at the end of the world. We will be accommodating."

events.summary: Enkindi, sent by Gideon, invites Drana's army to join Gideon's stand at Sea Gate.
events.quote: "Win. We can win. Many of you are still strong. We know what you can do in battle. Join us."

events.summary: Drana shows Enkindi the Orphans' Brigade of children and proposes he fight with her first before she goes to Sea Gate.
events.quote: I'll leave with you to fight with Gideon at Sea Gate, if you and your warriors fight with me first.

events.summary: The vampires, mortals and kor battle the three Eldrazi hosts, with the sire as the key target.
events.quote: Mortal and vampire alike met the initial onslaught with a fierce savagery.

events.summary: Drana orders the Orphans' Brigade toward the sire as bait; Enkindi calls her a monster but leads his kor at the sire.
events.quote: The children will serve as necessary bait to lure the sire where we need it to be.

events.summary: Enkindi is killed by the Eldrazi sire and the kor are slaughtered.
events.quote: Enkindi's headless corpse, still attached to its broken kitesail, plummeted uselessly to the ground.

events.summary: Drana bores into the sire's heart and drinks its energy, recovering memories of her origin as a creature of Ulamog.
events.quote: I was no longer an extension of it, of the consuming force named Ulamog.

events.summary: The Eldrazi energy overwhelms Drana, but she reasserts herself with 'I serve no one' and consumes the energy.
events.quote: I serve no one! I will be free!

events.summary: Drana releases the Eldrazi energy as a magenta sun that heals her army and destroys the Eldrazi, then collapses.
events.quote: I belong to no one . . . but they belong to me.

events.summary: Drana orders her survivors to cross to Tazeem to Sea Gate, having learned the Eldrazi have somewhere to go back to.
events.quote: "Make preparations to cross to Tazeem. We are going to Sea Gate."

relations.quote: all, vampire and mortal alike, bowed with her passing.

relations.note: One of her personal overseers for millennia.
relations.quote: Kan had been one of her personal overseers for millennia.

relations.note: Drove him and his traitors from Malakir.
relations.quote: Drana struck back, retaking control of Malakir and driving Kalitas and his traitors away from the city.

relations.note: She was made in the shadow of her makers and recalls being its extension.
relations.quote: I was no longer an extension of it, of the consuming force named Ulamog.
a smaller attached tentacle wrapped itself around Enkindi's head and squeezed.

relations.note: Sent by Gideon to find survivors.
relations.quote: he and the rest of his band had been sent by Gideon from Sea Gate

relations.note: A child soldier of the brigade.
Her people are being driven out by them.
relations.quote: she and her remaining people were driven from the city by ever-growing hordes of Eldrazi.
